māchinātor

māchinātor, māchinātōris m.

noun, third declension

an engineer, a builder of machines

In this lexicon

  • engineer

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 24.34.2: inventor ac māchinātor bellicōrum tormentōrum, of Archimedes (Lewis & Short); Sen. Ep. 88.22 (M-O s.v. mechanic: engineer); Tac. Ann. 15.42 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 166, 167, 310; M-O s.v. mechanic: engineer; Traupman 310
